title.narrative: EU RF 2.10 Renewable energy generation capacity installed (MW)

description.narrative: SDG 7 Affordable and clean energyEU RF statement Improved access to energy for all, and increased energy efficiency and renewable energy generationThis indicator is accompanied by a guidance note. Please consult here: https://resultsreporting.dev4u.it/document/methodnotes/2.10%20%20Renewable%20electricity%20installed%20capacity180808.pdf

comment.narrative: The baseline for the indicator is set at zero as no renewable energy infrastructure was present in the target areas prior to the intervention. This indicator will measure the total capacity of renewable energy systems installed as a result of the project. Progress will be tracked from the installation of the first renewable energy unit with data collected through project monitoring reports site assessments and verification by the monitoring and evaluation teams

The target is to install a total renewable energy generation capacity of 8 units by the end of the project. Progress towards this target will be tracked through detailed monitoring reports site inspections and monitoring and verifications.
